name: Peña Verde, S.A.B.
summary: Peña Verde, S.A.B. offers insurance and reinsurance services in Mexico, the Americas, the Caribbean, and internationally. The company offers insurance products, such as life, personal accidents, medical expenses, health, civil liability and professional risks, maritime and transportation, fire, agricultural and animal, credit, automobiles, and miscellaneous, as well as earthquake and other catastrophic. It also engages in the reinsurance and rebonding operations. The company was formerly known as Minera Peña Verde SA and changed its name to Peña Verde, S.A.B. in 1978. The company was incorporated in 1971 and is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
